title: black monday?
speaker: Matt (Trade Brigade)

macro_themes.view: Leadership (semis, memory, software) cracked; no new leaders and earnings are on the flattening side of the S-curve.
Bonds bid and yields falling with small caps weak is risk-off, not a healthy rate decline.
Hot CPI shelter means the Fed likely has to hike regardless of Hormuz; market prices pause next meeting with more hikes later.
VIX backwardation and elevated skew signal panic; a flip back to contango would be a buy signal.
